title: 第004章 藏好了别让她看到
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

舒楹能够理解谢亭渝的想法。

她手指掐着手心，脊背僵硬，强撑着没有回头，“我明天就搬走了，不会麻烦到你们。”

空气骤然安静。

谢亭渝眼眸低垂，视线正中是她天鹅般的脖颈和白皙立体的侧脸线条。

她很漂亮。

是经得起仔细审判、不惧岁月的那种漂亮。

比三年前瘦了，本就突出的五官被打磨得更加深刻，清清冷冷的杏眼扫过来，让人忍不住想窥探她眼睛里的故事。

“你也知道是麻烦。”谢亭渝嗤笑了一声。

舒楹正屏气凝神着，猝不及防他在她身旁落座，沉默着点了一根烟。

同一张长椅，中间的距离宛如天堑。

舒楹一跟谢亭渝独处就情绪紧绷，连同僵直的背部一起被他察觉到。

“你跟程二关系挺好。这么多年过去了，他还乐意帮你一把。”

舒楹不理解他的言外之意，敛眉道：“我跟他没闹过矛盾。”

“你的意思是，我让你不满了？”谢亭渝不明意味地笑了。

舒楹不太想争辩这种无聊的问题。无论是过去还是现在，他们之间都没有对错可言。

他大概也意识到这一点，慢慢变得沉默。

面前吐出一个烟圈，光影朦胧，空气沉闷而又压抑。

“不管你是为了什么回来的，不该惹的人，别惹。”谢亭渝没看她，话里警告的意味很浓。

舒楹不满地转头，第一眼注意到的却是他泛红的嘴唇。

是她的错觉吗？

伤口好像更肿了。

没等她想明白原因，谢亭渝起身走了。

舒楹懊恼地咬着唇角。

她摊开的手心有黏腻的汗渍，在这个乍暖还寒的春夜显得不那么合时宜。

她又没打算跟他扯上关系，没什么好心虚的。

她在心里提醒自己。

酒会还没结束，舒楹临时接到住家阿姨的电话，说绵绵白天受了惊吓，晚上哭着找她。

Page (1/3)

Shu Ying could understand Xie Tingyu's thoughts.

She pinched her palms with her fingers, her back stiffened, and she forced herself not to look back, "I will move out tomorrow, so I won't trouble you."

The air suddenly became quiet.

Xie Tingyu lowered his eyes, focusing on her swan-like neck and white three-dimensional profile.

She is beautiful.

It is the kind of beauty that can withstand careful judgment and is not afraid of time.

She is thinner than three years ago, and her already prominent facial features have been polished even more profoundly. Her cold, almond-shaped eyes glance over her, making people want to peek into the story in her eyes.

"You know it's trouble." Xie Tingyu sneered.

Shu Ying was holding her breath and concentrating when she was caught off guard and he sat down next to her and lit a cigarette in silence.

On the same bench, the distance between them is like a chasm.

As soon as Shu Ying was alone with Xie Tingyu, he became emotionally tense, which he noticed along with his stiff back.

"You have a good relationship with Cheng Er. After all these years, he is still willing to help you."

Shu Ying didn't understand what he meant and frowned, "I've never had any conflicts with him."

"You mean, I made you dissatisfied?" Xie Tingyu smiled inexplicably.

Shu Ying didn't want to argue on such a boring issue.There is no right or wrong between them, past or present.

He probably realized this and slowly became silent.

A ring of smoke blew out in front of him, the light and shadow were hazy, and the air was dull and depressing.

"No matter why you came back, don't mess with people you shouldn't mess with." Xie Tingyu didn't look at her, and his words contained a strong warning.

Shu Ying turned her head dissatisfied, and the first thing she noticed was his red lips.

Is it her imagination?

The wound seemed to be more swollen.

Before she could figure out the reason, Xie Tingyu got up and left.

Shu Ying bit her lip in frustration.

There were sticky sweat stains on her open palms, which seemed out of place on this spring night that was suddenly warm but still cold.

She had no intention of getting involved with him, so she had nothing to feel guilty about.

She reminded herself mentally.

Before the reception was over, Shu Ying received a call from the aunt at home, saying that Mianmian was frightened during the day and came to her crying at night.
